'''Sacorria Central Spaceport''' was a large, efficient [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located on the outskirts of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Saccorata]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. The spaceport contained a variety of hotels, bars and shops for use by off-worlders, and it also had a strong [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] presence. Due both its conveniences and the fact that the port was out of range of the [[Watchtower Base]] monitoring facility situated on [[Dorthus Tal Island]], the spaceport was favored by visitors to Sacorria.<ref name="CCW" />
